record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, add a learned projection of log1p(cumulative nonpadding prefix length)/log1p(64) to each historical input, keeping padding zero. This causal feature distinguishes short from established contexts without repeat counts. Jointly set maxlen=64, blocks=6, dropout=0.15 and LR=8e-4: shorter inputs fund six convolution blocks, while moderate dropout and a lower LR help retain the new length signal. Preserve item embeddings, convolution formulas, scoring and pointwise loss. Use one checkpoint/category, seed 42, 200 batches/epoch and at most 200 epochs; update predictor metadata and writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, add a jointly learned projection of normalized log cumulative nonpadding prefix length. This causal feature distinguishes short and established contexts using observed history alone, with zero contribution at padding. The predictor imports the updated model class, and existing maxlen metadata supplies the same normalization at inference; the projection weights are saved in each category's single checkpoint.

Jointly use maxlen=64, six convolution blocks, dropout=0.15 and learning rate=8e-4 across all four datasets. The shorter window funds six blocks, while moderate dropout and a lower learning rate support learning the prefix-length feature. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate the changed dimensions and block count.
